links.outcome: Diagnostic correctness of multimodal LLM responses to pediatric rash vignettes versus reference diagnosis
links.effect: At least one platform missed the reference diagnosis in 9/15 vignettes; all three missed porphyria. 82.2% of CUS ratings were in categories 4-5.
links.quote: In the single-query diagnostic assessment, at least one platform missed the reference diagnosis in 9/15 vignettes, and all three missed porphyria.

screen.reason: Empirical expert evaluation of multimodal LLMs on pediatric rash vignettes, assessing safety, utility, and diagnostic correctness without testing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
